concept_decisions: Actual concept pixels inspected: retain broad paired benches and clear risers, reject highly repeated horizontal texture bands and vegetation. One original closed terrain volume with top levels11m and3m; risers8m high. Slight unequal natural bank edges and modest river curvature. Opaque finite water strip top2.6m within lower active floodplain. No oxbow, trees, multilevel staircase, large canyon shoulders or incidental rocks. Actual NPS Chaco authoritative diagram supplies explicit terrace versus floodplain versus innerchannel cross-section; USGS terrace photo is contextual only and not a scale source.
